text: The provided text is a single, cohesive paragraph that lacks structural hierarchy. It does not contain any headings, subheadings, or distinct sections to organize the information. The content flows linearly from one sentence to the next without the use of transitional phrases to signal shifts in topic or emphasis. Specifically, the text moves from a directive ("Describe the primary material...") to a description of lecture note structure ("The lecture notes start with...") and then to specific features ("There are highlighted terms...") and a conclusion ("the notes conclude with..."). This lack of visual or textual markers makes it difficult to distinguish between the subject matter (candle material) and the meta-description of the lecture notes' format. To improve organization, the text could be divided into sections with clear headings, such as "Topic Overview," "Note Structure," and "Key Features," and transitions could be added to clarify the relationship between the directive and the description of the notes.
